topics.title: Business objectives
topics.question: What business outcome should the new onboarding deliver, and how will you measure it (e.g. completion rate, time-to-onboard, cost per KYC)?
topics.followup: You mentioned an objective without a measurable target. What number would count as success, and by when?

topics.title: Users and roles
topics.question: Who will use the onboarding journey and back-office screens (customer segments, staff roles), and what can each role do?
topics.followup: Which customer types are in scope for phase 1: individuals only, or also sole proprietors and legal entities?

topics.title: Existing workflow
topics.question: Walk me through how onboarding and KYC are done today. Where are the manual steps, hand-offs and delays?
topics.followup: Which step in the current process causes the most rework or customer drop-off?

topics.title: Inputs, outputs and business rules
topics.question: Which documents and data fields must be collected, and what rules decide accept, reject or refer?
topics.followup: What exactly should happen when a document fails verification? Retry, alternate document, or manual review?

topics.title: Exceptional conditions
topics.question: What should happen when something goes wrong, such as a vendor timeout, name mismatch, blurred document or partial sanctions match?
topics.followup: If the identity-verification vendor is down, should onboarding queue, fail over to another provider, or pause?

topics.title: Data collection and retention
topics.question: How long must KYC data, documents, video recordings and biometric templates be kept, and when must they be deleted?
topics.followup: Is the retention period counted from account opening or from the end of the relationship, and does it differ for rejected applicants?

topics.title: Authentication and authorisation
topics.question: How should customers and staff authenticate, and which staff roles may view unmasked identity data?
topics.followup: Which actions need step-up authentication or maker-checker approval?

topics.title: Financial transaction limits
topics.question: Are there account or transaction limits tied to the KYC level (for example minimum-KYC or small accounts) before full verification is complete?
topics.followup: What limit applies until full KYC is complete, and what happens when it is reached?

topics.title: Audit and reporting
topics.question: Which audit trails, regulatory reports and MIS dashboards are required, and who consumes them?
topics.followup: Which events must be in the audit trail, and must it be tamper-evident?

topics.title: Performance and availability
topics.question: What are the response-time, throughput, peak-load and availability expectations for onboarding?
topics.followup: You said it should be 'fast'. What is the maximum acceptable end-to-end time and per-step latency at peak load?

topics.title: Integration with existing systems
topics.question: Which internal systems and external services must onboarding integrate with (core banking, CRM, screening vendor, KYC registry, e-sign)?
topics.followup: What are the interface constraints of the legacy core banking system (batch windows, message formats, rate limits)?

topics.title: Regulatory and security constraints
topics.question: Which jurisdictions and regulations apply, and are there open audit findings or regulator observations on KYC?
topics.followup: Are customers from outside the primary jurisdiction in scope, and if so which additional rules apply?

topics.title: Schedule and budget
topics.question: What is the target go-live date, budget envelope and team capacity, and is there a regulatory deadline?
topics.followup: Is the go-live date fixed by a regulatory or business commitment, or can scope be phased?
